description: This Java class defines an immutable EntityTagMatcher used for comparing entity-tags, including support for wildcards (asterisk). It provides methods for creating matchers from strings, validating, and performing strong and weak matches against entity-tags.

classes.name: EntityTagMatcher
classes.description: Immutable class for matching entity-tags with support for wildcards and comparison methods.

methods.name: fromString
methods.description: Creates an EntityTagMatcher from a string, handling wildcards and parsing entity-tags.

methods.name: isAsterisk
methods.description: Checks if a given string is the asterisk wildcard.

methods.name: asterisk
methods.description: Returns a singleton instance representing the wildcard '*' matcher.

methods.name: isValid
methods.description: Validates whether a string is a valid entity-tag matcher (either an asterisk or a valid entity-tag).

methods.name: strongMatch
methods.description: Performs a strong comparison match with an entity-tag.

methods.name: weakMatch
methods.description: Performs a weak comparison match with an entity-tag.

methods.name: isAsterisk
methods.description: Indicates whether this matcher instance represents the wildcard '*'.
